admin.usersIntro: Create staff accounts and assign one of the four roles. Role and status changes take effect on the account's next action; deactivating or resetting a password signs the account out immediately.

admin.mediaIntro: Upload validated images and documents once and reuse them across records. Images are served from a stable public URL; documents stay private.
admin.mediaUploadFailed: The upload failed. Please try again.
admin.mediaInUse: This media is still used by a record and cannot be archived or purged.

admin.noMediaBody: Upload your first image or document to build the shared library.
admin.brandsIntro: Create and publish brands with bilingual copy, media (logo/cover), origin, categories and social links. Draft changes stay private until you publish.
admin.productsIntro: Manage the product catalogue: each product belongs to a brand, at least one category, optional images and bilingual specifications.
admin.categoriesIntro: Manage the typed category taxonomy (brand, product, supplier). Categories support two levels; order them with the sort value and activate or deactivate as needed.
admin.suppliersIntro: Manage supplier profiles with bilingual copy, categories and contact details. Disclosure must be approved before a supplier can appear publicly.
admin.clientsIntro: Manage client references. A client stays confidential until disclosure is approved, and only approved + published clients appear publicly.
admin.locationsIntro: Manage the corporate locations. Coordinates are optional and never invented; a location appears publicly only when verified and published.
